aiOverview.content: The main 2026 Brooklyn Half Marathon options are the NYCRUNS Brooklyn Experience Half Marathon on April 26, 2026 and the 2026 RBC Brooklyn Half on May 16, 2026. The NYCRUNS event offers a waterfront, city-focused route, while the NYRR RBC Brooklyn Half typically goes from Prospect Park to Coney Island. Both are major, high-capacity events. Key 2026 Brooklyn Half Marathons: NYCRUNS Brooklyn Experience Half Marathon Date: Sunday, April 26, 2026 Details: Starts in North Brooklyn, features historic neighborhoods and waterfront views, ending in the borough. Size: Over 25,000 runners expected. RBC Brooklyn Half (NYRR) Date: Saturday, May 16, 2026 Details: A classic 13.1-mile journey starting at Prospect Park and finishing at the Coney Island boardwalk. Features: Often allows for 4 Out of 6 qualifying credit or 9+1 program, with a $126.90 fee mentioned. United Airlines NYC Half (Starts in Brooklyn) Date: Sunday, March 15, 2026 Details: While technically an NYC race, this large event starts near the Brooklyn Museum, runs through Prospect Park, and crosses the Brooklyn Bridge. Tips for 2026 Registration: NYCRUNS: Generally sells out quickly; registering early is advised. NYRR RBC: Often uses a lottery system or sells out quickly due to high demand, so keep an eye on the New York Road Runners website for opening dates. Note: For the most up-to-date information, including specific registration links and road closures, it is best to check the official NYCRUNS and NYRR websites directly.
